scope: T1 final candidate pool sealed as test only; no training, no Isaac run, no model evaluation in this step

sampling.rule: N=1: all accepted frames are included because the independently recounted accepted total is <= 400; the 18 WARMUP frames stay in the manifest with accepted=false and are excluded from training/evaluation
sampling.fallback_rule_if_gt_400: per family, sort accepted frames by sequence, k = ceil(total_accepted/400), take every k-th starting from the first accepted frame; sequence order only, no model score and no random choice
sampling.lead_expectation_note: the hand-off expected the raw accepted pool to exceed 200-400 and require sampling; the independent recount is 279 accepted (297 RGB frames including 18 WARMUP), so the fixed rule N=1 keeps every accepted frame and no sampling is triggered
sampling.recount_note: accepted is recounted from observations.jsonl as gate.accepted AND validity.valid AND phase==RUN; the RGB frame total includes 3 WARMUP frames per episode

source.nature: capture-derived camera pose / distance / bearing / green-pixel geometry, independently aggregated here; the frame set is cross-checked against the accepted frames recounted from observations.jsonl

condition_matrix.status: MISSING: the negative is target-absent with <=3 px green false clues; no verified similar-structure label exists, so it must not be reported as HN1-covered

condition_coverage.far_range_note: around 7-8.4 m the green light is 0-1 px; T6 should allow UNAVAILABLE reference labels there

family_independence.note: start-pose proximity is NOT trajectory identity; all families use new E-area / MID-field waypoint sequences, not the south or north corridors. The closest pairs are lmf_edge vs pilot_east_center (0.30 m, yaw differs 0.60 rad) and lmf_similar_negative vs pilot_east_away (0.54 m, same yaw). T6/T5 must report this adjacency; byte sha differs and the closest image pair still differs by >=7.7/255 mean abs.

pool_adequacy.note: six new families and 279 accepted frames satisfy the T5 fresh-family and 200-400 budget; condition coverage is partial (no HN1, no constructed occlusion).

t1_report.note: the Lead hand-off said the T1 report was not yet on disk; it is present at seal time and its hash is recorded here

provenance.hash_source: sha256 of file bytes; raw files stay in ignored outputs/ except the capture report copies

dev_freeze_reference.role: dev train/val split v2; family and frame-sha disjointness is checked against this freeze

planned_pilot_annotation.produced_by: T6 pilot annotation, not this freeze

annotation_status.labels_git_status: not in git; raw labels stay in ignored outputs/ and only path + hash are recorded
